pairs.question: Quaenam esset causa quare non procederet exercitus?
pairs.answer: Hostes, fluvium obtinentes, nostros non permittebant accedere.
pairs.derivation: The emperor, in command of the rear, asks (reported) why the army is not advancing. Dropped the framing/narration that precedes the question ("nuntiatur domino imperatori qui posterioribus praeerat agminibus, sciscitanti:"). The answer is the operative reply reported with the indirect-statement conjunction "quod" stripped as framing ("quod hostes, fluvium obtinentes..."), normalized to a capital and full stop; it genuinely answers the question. What follows the answer turns to narration: "Quo cognito, ira succensus..." (the emperor charges to the river).
